## Key Projects

### [Vurlo](https://theayush.pages.dev/projects/vurlo) (Full-Stack E-commerce SaaS)
- **Case Study URL**: [theayush.pages.dev/projects/vurlo](https://theayush.pages.dev/projects/vurlo)
- **Role**: Founder & Lead Architect
- **Build Time**: 10 Days
- **Key Metrics**: 100/100 Lighthouse SEO, 0 inventory oversells, under 400ms loading latency.
- **Architecture**: Atomic inventory check-and-decrement transactions in Firestore preventing race conditions. Multi-point rollback handlers for aborted payment SDK exits. Server-side payment verification via HMAC-SHA256. Resend mail queues and Gemini recommendation slots.

### [Carrel](https://theayush.pages.dev/projects/carrel) (Real-Time Collaborative Workspace)
- **Case Study URL**: [theayush.pages.dev/projects/carrel](https://theayush.pages.dev/projects/carrel)
- **Repository**: [github.com/theayushagarwal/carrel](https://github.com/theayushagarwal/carrel)
- **Stack**: TypeScript monorepo (`@carrel/shared`, `@carrel/server`, `@carrel/client`), Fastify, Yjs CRDT, WebSockets, better-sqlite3 (WAL), CodeMirror 6, Playwright.
- **Architecture**: Multiplexes Yjs sync (`0`), awareness (`1`), and JSON control (`2`) frames over a single raw WebSocket. Hardened with single-use nonce HMAC tickets, concurrency-4 async scrypt rate limiting, 5000ms host grace succession, and 80ms lerped remote carets.

### [AegisFlow](https://theayush.pages.dev/projects/aegisflow) (Autonomous Cluster Telemetry & Bayesian Scheduler)
- **Case Study URL**: [theayush.pages.dev/projects/aegisflow](https://theayush.pages.dev/projects/aegisflow)
- **Repository**: [github.com/theayushagarwal/AegisFlow](https://github.com/theayushagarwal/AegisFlow)
- **Stack**: Pure Python (zero external dependencies).
- **Key Metrics**: 99.58% HMM state accuracy, -87% deadline misses, 98.3% on-time completion, 0.00 unnecessary migrations, 0.64 ms/step latency, 96% Oracle ceiling, 31/31 invariants passing.
- **Architecture**: Exact 3-state Bayesian Hidden Markov Model inferring hidden node health (`0.13s–0.35s` detection), paired with analytical triage gating, cold-restart expected-value barrier, and defensive recovery probation ramp.

### [Chronosync](https://theayush.pages.dev/projects/chronosync) (Autonomous Web Monitor & Visual Regression Studio)
- **Case Study URL**: [theayush.pages.dev/projects/chronosync](https://theayush.pages.dev/projects/chronosync)
- **Repository**: [github.com/theayushagarwal/Chronosync](https://github.com/theayushagarwal/Chronosync)
- **Stack**: Python, FastAPI, Playwright, SQLite, Docker, Vanilla JS, Groq API.
- **Architecture**: Deduplicates normalized URLs across watchers (`pages` vs `watches`), classifies outages/CAPTCHAs before diffing, suppresses dynamic clocks/CSRF noise across 4 layers with 2-check persistence, and ships a Visual Diff Studio (swipe slider, pixel heatmap, unified diff, SVG charts) backed by 29 tests.

### [Veltrix](https://theayush.pages.dev/projects/veltrix) (Autonomous Social Engine)
- **Case Study URL**: [theayush.pages.dev/projects/veltrix](https://theayush.pages.dev/projects/veltrix)
- **Role**: Solo Developer
- **Cadence**: 2 automated posts/day
- **Operational Cost**: ~$0.0002 per post
- **Architecture**: Multimodel adversarial loop. Gemini 2.0 Flash drafts captions; Groq (Llama) and Cerebras act as independent auditors. Posts are committed only if both auditors agree. Renders carousels and images via Jinja2 templates into headless Playwright browsers at native DPI resolutions.

### [Vcentre](https://theayush.pages.dev/projects/vcentre) (Competitor Intelligence Scraper)
- **Case Study URL**: [theayush.pages.dev/projects/vcentre](https://theayush.pages.dev/projects/vcentre)
- **Role**: Solo Developer
- **Cadence**: Daily @ 2:00 AM UTC
- **Stack**: Python, Apify, FastAPI, SQLite
- **Architecture**: Nightly scraping of target competitor channels. Separates Reels and Photos into cohort-specific baselines to prevent viral inflation. Filters outliers using a 3x-median engagement check, runs findings through a 10-provider LLM fallback chain, and generates production creative briefs.
